entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to return something. I just feel so disappointed. I saved up for these new cycling shoes and they're just not working out.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're disappointed. I can certainly look into the return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

It's the fit. I took them on one ride and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I tried adjusting the cleats, thinking that might help my foot position, but it didn't change anything. They just hurt.

I see, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I understand that's frustrating. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get your name and order number, please?

Yes, it's Anya Sharma. The order number is VF886-01. I just... I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back if they weren't going to work. I can't afford to just have them sitting in a box.
Thank you, Anya. I appreciate you providing that. Let me see... Okay, I have your order right here for the Pro-Lace cycling shoes. I see they were delivered just last week, on January 6th.
That's right. Is... is it going to be a problem? I know I wore them once.

Not at all. Since these are a standard item, they fall under our 90-day return policy. You are well within that timeframe. I can absolutely process a full refund for you. I'll email you a pre-paid return label right now. You just need to box up the shoes and drop them off.
Oh, really? A full refund? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried.

You're very welcome, Anya. We want to make sure you're happy. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
